steps.title: Play first!
steps.text: Press Play and try the level: run with the arrow keys, jump with Space, collect coins and reach the flag.

steps.title: The player is made of blocks
steps.text: Open the player's blocks. 'every frame' sets the speed from the arrow keys, and 'when space key pressed' makes it jump, but only when it's on the ground.

steps.title: Change how it feels
steps.text: Select the Player: the Script section in the Inspector shows 'Speed' and 'Jump Power'. Try a speed of 9 and a jump power of 15, then play again. These come from the variables in the blocks.

steps.title: Coins use EasyScript
steps.text: Open coin.es. When something touches the coin, it checks whether it's the player, adds 1 to game.coins, plays a sound and deletes itself.

steps.title: Build more level
steps.text: Select a Platform (they're in the Level folder in the Hierarchy) and press Ctrl+D to duplicate it, then drag the copy somewhere new. Duplicate coins and slimes the same way: the copy stays in the same folder. Everything with the 'hazard' tag hurts the player.

steps.title: Challenge
